title: Farm
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Location |type = [[Farming]] location |x = 65 |y = 71 |z = -82 |location = [[Hub Island]] |music = "[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Hub|Hub]]" |sublocations = *[[Communal Stew]] *[[Farmhouse]] |resources = *Wheat *Seeds *Milk Bucket }} The '''Farm''' is an area for the player to obtain {{Skl|Farming}} levels early in the game. It can be found north-east of the {{Zone|Village}} on the {{Zone|Hub Island}}. {{ZoneText|Learn about the Farming Skill at &eFarmer Rigby&f.|Gather &eWheat&f.|Learn about Minion Upgrades at &eArthur&f.|Travel to &eThe Barn&f.}} == Purpose == The Farm includes five different {{Item|Wheat}} farming areas though this is the only [[Crops (disambiguation)|crop]] available to the player. The wheat is constantly regrown by wheat [[Floating Crystals|crystals]] above them. A {{Item|Wheat Minion}} is on display, and its inventory can be accessed and looted. It always holds an {{Item|Enchanted Bread}}, a {{Item|Budget Hopper}}, and a {{Item|Compactor}}. The NPC nearby, {{NPCSprite|Arthur}}, explains certain things about [[Minions]]. A small shack contains the cow {{NPCSprite|Shania}} and {{NPCSprite|Farmer Rigby}}, who will request wheat from the player. Left-clicking Shania with a {{Item|Bucket}} allows you to obtain the {{Item|Magical Milk Bucket}}. Right-clicking gives regular milk. There is a launchpad leading to {{Zone|the barn}}. == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Fairy Souls == {{Fairy Souls}} == Tips == It is recommended that you farm here for {{Item|Wheat}} rather than at {{Zone|the barn}}, due to large wheat fields that are rarely looted by players and regrow quickly. == Trivia == * The [[Wheat Minion]] in [[Farm|the Farm]] can be looted, but the upgrades and the fuel cannot be taken out. Trying to do so will show a message in the chat:
{{Color|Yellow|[NPC] Arthur}}: Sorry but that's mine! * Interestingly, this minion can be upgraded, however the upgrade gets reverted when the server restarts. == Gallery == Farm (Render).png|Farm, post-[[0.24.2]] update Farm (Post-0.8.1).png|Farm, post-[[0.8.1]] update Farm (Pre-0.8.1).png|Farm, pre-[[0.8.1]] update == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jan 30|Moved and updated the look of the '''Farm''', due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} |beta= {{History|0.1|Added {{zone|Farm}}.}} {{History|0.8.1|Updated the design of {{zone|Farm}}.}} {{History|0.24.2|Moved and updated the look of the '''Farm''', due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Locations}}
